notes: One handwritten page on groups, homogeneous spaces, pointed equivariant maps, torsors and change of base point in a torsor automorphism description. The page has one two-part underlined main heading and one underlined Torseur heading. No date or document count is present.

Only the named whole image and named halves were viewed, each once, followed by one visual inspection of each of 12 distinct saved crops. No OCR, recognition library, text layer, web, other page or other reader was used. The whole image measures 1682 × 2361 pixels. Half a measures 1682 × 1260; half b measures 1682 × 1261 and starts at original y=1100.
Crop boxes and rotation are in crops/manifest.json. Crop 03 alone is rotated (-43 degrees). Crops were enlarged with LANCZOS after autocontrast and sharpened; the original image was not altered.

The final text keeps the literal 1 after the existential sign, sss, ss, the wave-only relation in the automorphism sentence, the unmatched parenthesis after the nonemptiness condition, and the mismatch gx/u_gx versus the later s-based calculation.

The author's own doubt marks are a live question mark in the box and a question mark crossed together with a leftward arrow below the second central equation. Their certainty as visible question marks is distinct from the editorial unsure macros.
No separate drawing occurs. Both diagrams are returned in tikz-cd; the lower computation preserves the bracket and the right-hand continuation block.
The faint lower-left 2 is archive foliation, represented only by a TeX comment.
S.json contains no sweep rows, so there are no S decisions to report.

diff_c and diff_h compare content, deletion/insertion state and significant placement with each witness primary reading. Removing a doubt marker while retaining its first candidate alone is not counted as a substantive difference. Every C doubt nevertheless has an explicit resolve or retain finding.
Reading and checking are distinguished: the local conjugation calculation was checked conditionally as described below. No overall theorem about the group law on Aut_G P was independently verified.

checks.statement: If y=sx and u_y(g) is G-equivariant, then u_y(g)x=s^{-1}gsx, hence u_y(g)=u_x(s^{-1}gs) when equivariant maps are determined by x.
checks.reasoning: Equivariance gives u_y(g)(sx)=s u_y(g)x. The defining equality u_y(g)y=gy and y=sx give s u_y(g)x=gsx; acting by s^{-1} yields the displayed conjugation. The preceding NB supplies the determination by the image of x under a transitive action.
checks.outcome: The surviving s-based local calculation is consistent under those hypotheses. The earlier literal gx and u_gx do not use the same replacement letter and were preserved, not silently changed.
